title: find understand use nonpriority must not block
rule: Find / understand / use; non-priority must not block findability. Every design decision is judged on those three. Group the same public topic across departments; remove duplicate content. Do not publish what GC is not the authoritative source for — link out instead.

citation.source: Canada.ca — Designing content; Designing content for Canada.ca

pass_when: Non-priority content does not hide the findable task; duplicate public topics are grouped/removed; non-authoritative material is a link out.
fail_when: Extra non-priority blocks findability; duplicate departmental pages for the same public topic; GC publishes what it is not the source for.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
